definitions.explanation: An inevitable course of events or situation determined by fate. Often used when accepting something as unavoidable.
An established rule, law, or regulation that must be followed.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定|さだ}めな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だろう。
examples.english: I suppose this is my fate.
It is the fate of all people to someday die.

examples.english: I have no choice but to accept what fate has decided and move forward.

examples.english: If you violate the provisions of the contract, a fine will be imposed.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Noun form of {定|さだ}める (to determine, to establish).

TWO MAIN MEANINGS:

1. FATE/DESTINY:
Used when accepting something as predetermined or inevitable:
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定|さだ}め - fate's decree
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定|さだ}め - human destiny
- ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定|さだ}め - death is certain

This usage is literary and philosophical.

2. RULE/REGULATION:
More formal/written usage for established rules:
- ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定|さだ}め - provisions of law
- {会則|かいそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定|さだ}め - organizational rules

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定|さだ}めだ - ~ is fate/inevitable
- {定|さだ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ - to follow the rules/fate
- {定|さだ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧ - to accept one's fate
- {定|さだ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ - to change one's fate

SIMILAR WORDS (Fate):
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧ - fate, destiny (common)
- ⟦{宿命|しゅくめい}→宿命：07401_shukumei⟧ - fate, destiny (emphasizes being predetermined)
- ⟦{天命|てんめい}→天命：07887_tenmei⟧ - divine will, heaven's decree
- ⟦{因縁|いんねん}→因縁：07460_innen⟧ - karmic fate

SIMILAR WORDS (Rule):
- ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ - rule (common)
- ⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧ - regulation, provision
- ⟦{決|き}まり→決まり：02548_kimari⟧ - rule, custom

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary/formal for the "fate" meaning. More technical for the "rule" meaning.
